description: This file provides utility functions for the HTTP Webs Trans Object, most notably the factory function `HttpCreateWebsTrans` which creates instances of the Webs Trans object. It includes licensing info, general comments, and the implementation of a single function that delegates object creation to `HttpWstoCreate`.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpCreateWebsTrans(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a new Http Webs Trans object, delegating to `HttpWstoCreate`.
